inexplicably--adv.def: In a way that cannot be explained.

cleverness--noun.def: The quality of being quick to learn and to solve problems.

fanciful--adj.def: Imagined rather than based on fact.

monotony--noun.def: The dullness of something that never changes.

resonate--verb.def: To make a deep sound, or to feel true to many people.
resonate--verb.ex: The message resonated with young voters.

rediscover--verb.def: To find or to enjoy something again after a long time.
rediscover--verb.ex: She rediscovered her love of painting.

retention--noun.def: The act of keeping something, or keeping it in memory.

renown--noun.def: The state of being known and admired by many.
renown--noun.ex: The surgeon is of international renown.

gush--verb.def: To flow out quickly in large amounts.
gush--verb.ex: Water gushed from the broken pipe.

gush--noun.def: A sudden strong flow of liquid.
gush--noun.ex: A gush of steam filled the room.

unoccupied--adj.def: Empty, with nobody living in or using it.
unoccupied--adj.ex: The flat has been unoccupied for a year.

motley--adj.def: Made up of many different and mismatched parts.
motley--adj.ex: A motley group gathered at the gate.

wooded--adj.ex: The path crosses a wooded valley.

repute--verb.def: To be generally said to be something, in formal English.
repute--verb.ex: The spring is reputed to cure illness.

remedial--adj.def: Intended to correct a problem or to help weak students.

insubordinate--adj.def: Refusing to obey someone in authority.

compliant--adj.def: Obeying rules, or too willing to agree.
compliant--adj.ex: The building is compliant with the code.

resilience--noun.def: The ability to recover quickly from difficulty.

assertion--noun.def: A confident statement that something is true.

inclusion--noun.def: The act of including someone or something.

commercially--adv.def: In a way relating to business and profit.

suburbia--noun.def: The suburbs and the way of life found there.
suburbia--noun.ex: The novel is set in suburbia.

negligible--adj.def: So small that it is not worth considering.

suds--noun.def: The bubbles made by soap in water.
suds--noun.ex: Her hands were covered in suds.

adjustable--adj.def: Able to be changed to suit different needs.

aimless--adj.def: Having no clear purpose or direction.

altruistic--adj.def: Caring about others more than about yourself.

untangle--verb.def: To separate things that are twisted together.

overdraft--verb.def: To take out more money than an account holds.
overdraft--verb.ex: He overdrafted the account by mistake.

overdraft--noun.def: The amount by which a bank account goes below zero.
overdraft--noun.ex: The bank charges for an overdraft.
overdraft--noun.exTr: Banka eksi bakiye için ücret alıyor.

conformity--noun.def: Behaviour that follows accepted rules or customs.

organizational--adj.def: Relating to how a group is arranged and run.

altruism--noun.def: The practice of caring for others before yourself.

exuberant--adj.def: Full of lively energy and happiness.

congregate--verb.def: To come together in a group.

symptomatic--adj.def: Being a sign of a larger problem.
symptomatic--adj.ex: The delay is symptomatic of poor planning.

toughness--noun.def: The quality of being strong and hard to damage.
toughness--noun.ex: The toughness of the glass surprised us.

artistically--adv.def: In a way that shows artistic skill.

acutely--adv.ex: She was acutely aware of the silence.

inexhaustible--adj.def: Existing in such large amounts that it never runs out.
inexhaustible--adj.ex: He has an inexhaustible supply of stories.

irate--adj.ex: An irate customer demanded a refund.
irate--adj.exTr: Öfkeli bir müşteri para iadesi istedi.

exuberance--noun.ex: The exuberance of the crowd was catching.

pathos--noun.def: A quality in a story that makes you feel pity.
pathos--noun.ex: The final scene has real pathos.

raunchy--adj.def: Sexually suggestive in a bold way.

tantamount--adj.def: Equal in effect to something bad.
tantamount--adj.ex: Silence here is tantamount to consent.

fabulously--adv.def: Extremely, in a way that seems unreal.

collaborative--adj.def: Done by two or more people working together.

hibernate--verb.def: To sleep through the winter, said of some animals.
hibernate--verb.exTr: Kaplumbağalar yaprakların altında kış uykusuna yatar.

favorably--adv.def: In a way that shows approval or advantage.
favorably--adv.ex: The plan compares favorably with the old one.

interject--verb.def: To say something that interrupts a speaker.
interject--verb.exTr: Araya girip hızlı bir soru sordu.

detriment--noun.ex: He worked long hours to the detriment of his health.

utensil--noun.def: A tool used in the kitchen.
utensil--noun.ex: Wash every utensil in hot water.
utensil--noun.exTr: Her mutfak gerecini sıcak suda yıka.

ornamental--adj.def: Kept for its beauty rather than for use.

misplace--verb.def: To put something where you cannot find it again.

dislodge--verb.def: To force something out of its fixed position.

marginally--adv.def: By only a very small amount.

complementary--adj.def: Working well together because each adds what the other lacks.

self-worth--noun.def: The sense that you have value as a person.
self-worth--noun.ex: The job restored his self worth.
self-worth--noun.exTr: İş onun öz değerini geri kazandırdı.

sprawl--noun.def: The spreading of a city over a wide area.

sprawl--verb.def: To spread out untidily over a large area.
sprawl--verb.ex: The town sprawls along the coast.

torturous--adj.def: Extremely painful or unpleasant to endure.

structurally--adv.def: In a way relating to the structure of something.

heighten--verb.def: To make a feeling or an effect stronger.

aesthetically--adv.def: In a way relating to beauty.

ventilate--verb.def: To let fresh air move through a room.
ventilate--verb.ex: Ventilate the room before you paint.

mountaineer--noun.ex: The mountaineer reached the summit alone.

panoramic--adj.def: Giving a wide view of a large area.
panoramic--adj.ex: The room has a panoramic view.

glean--verb.def: To collect information slowly and with difficulty.
glean--verb.ex: We gleaned the facts from old letters.

crudely--adv.def: In a rough or unskilled way.

settee--noun.def: A long soft seat for two or more people.
settee--noun.ex: Three of us squeezed onto the settee.

reenact--verb.def: To perform the events of the past again.
reenact--verb.ex: Volunteers reenact the battle each year.
reenact--verb.exTr: Gönüllüler savaşı her yıl yeniden canlandırıyor.

beguiling--adj.def: Attractive in a way that may be deceptive.
beguiling--adj.ex: The offer is beguiling but risky.
